decisions.reason: As an adjacent consumer-health line with dedicated website presence, it supports the firm's portfolio-broadening strategy and can be distributed efficiently through pharmacies.
The product received a clearly promoted launch and fits the firm's OTC and pharmacy customer base, so it is worth continuing as part of consumer health expansion.
A joint-health supplement is a natural extension of the firm's established healthcare offering, and a recent 2018 launch should be given more time to build market traction.

This mushroom-based immune supplement appears relatively niche and had only limited website prominence, making it a weaker fit for a quality-focused pharmaceutical portfolio than the other new launches.

Despite the 2018 valsartan-related issue, a generic blood-pressure medicine supports the firm's prescription and generics business and should be retained if sourcing and quality controls have been stabilized.
